summary: Request: Create HubSpot campaign + tagging fields for Benchmark Report launch attribution
description:
Requester: Tyler Benson (Marketing Ops)

Background
We’re launching the public Benchmark Report (latency/$) with multiple GTM surfaces (landing page, interactive table, PDF download, blog, webinar registration, lifecycle email, partner co-marketing). We need a single, consistent HubSpot campaign + standardized tagging so we can report:
- Traffic/signups influenced by the benchmark assets
- Demo requests + SQLs attributed/influenced
- Influenced pipeline for Dedicated/Private motions

Request
1) Create a new HubSpot Campaign for the launch and ensure it is available for association on:
- Forms (PDF download, webinar registration, “Request a demo”, “Talk to an expert”)
- CTAs on the benchmark landing page / interactive benchmark page
- Lifecycle emails related to the launch

2) Define/enable standardized campaign identifiers to be used across:
- UTM parameters (utm_campaign, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_content)
- HubSpot tracking URLs
- Any manual association rules in workflows (if needed)

3) Add/confirm reporting fields/properties so the campaign can be used in dashboards and deal attribution views:
- Contact level: First-touch campaign, Last-touch campaign, Most recent campaign (if not already available)
- Deal level: Primary campaign source / campaign association (or best-practice equivalent)
- Ensure we can filter influenced pipeline by this campaign

Proposed naming conventions (please confirm or adjust)
- HubSpot Campaign name: "2025 Benchmark Report: Latency per $" (internal)
- Campaign slug (for UTMs): "benchmark-report-latency-per-dollar-2025"
- Optional short: "benchmark-report-2025"

Assets to associate
- Landing page + interactive table (marketing site)
- PDF download form (gated) and any ungated PDF link tracking (if applicable)
- Blog post announcement
- Webinar registration + post-webinar follow-up emails
- Partner amplification links (marketplace/newsletters)

Acceptance criteria
- One canonical HubSpot campaign exists and is visible to Marketing/Sales
- Campaign is associated to all relevant forms/emails/CTAs
- UTM guidance is documented in the ticket so Growth/PMM/Partners can use it consistently
- We can generate a report for: Sessions -> Contacts -> MQL/SQL -> Deals influenced, filtered by the campaign

Notes/constraints
- We need this ready before internal review of the launch email + landing page final links (target: by end of week).
- If HubSpot’s campaign association at the deal level is limited, propose a workaround (e.g., workflow to stamp a deal property from associated contact’s most recent campaign at deal create time; or manual association guidance for AEs).

References
- Launch attribution spec: post-launch KPI dashboard spec (Google Drive)
- Related request context: benchmark report launch plan & asset list (PM ticket)

Requested due date: 2025-06-21
comments: 2025-06-18 10:14 PT — Tyler Benson: Creating this as an internal support ticket because we need the campaign object + properties standardized before Growth finalizes tracking URLs for email + partner links. Happy to jump on a quick call if needed.

2025-06-19 09:11 PT — Ben Carter: +1 umbrella campaign. We’ll differentiate email variants and partner placements via utm_source/utm_content. Please share the final campaign slug so we can lock it into the A/B test plan.

2025-06-19 11:47 PT — Isabelle Laurent: Implementing:

For deal-level influenced pipeline, I’ll add a workflow to copy “Latest campaign” to a new deal property on deal create (see next update).

- Created campaign and set owner = Tyler Benson
- Associated campaign to forms: PDF Download (Benchmark Report), Webinar Registration (Benchmark Launch)
- Shared tracking URL builder guidance with Growth + PMM

resolution: Created HubSpot Campaign “2025 Benchmark Report: Latency per $” with canonical utm_campaign=benchmark-report-latency-per-dollar-2025. Associated campaign to benchmark PDF + webinar forms and provided UTM/tracking URL guidance. Added deal-level property + workflow to stamp campaign influence at deal creation for influenced pipeline reporting. Documented manual fallback for SDR-created deals.
